description: This file implements a process monitoring system for managing subprocesses, including starting, stopping, suspending, resuming, and handling subprocess exit events. It also facilitates communication between parent and child processes via socket channels, with specific handling for Linux systems.

classes.name: ProcessMonitor
classes.description: A class responsible for managing subprocesses, including starting, stopping, suspending, resuming, and monitoring their lifecycle, as well as inter-process communication.

classes.name: ProcessMonitor::Properties
classes.description: A nested class within ProcessMonitor that holds configuration and state information for the monitored subprocesses, including command lists, flags, and communication channels.

methods.name: StartSubprocesses
methods.description: Starts all subprocesses defined in the properties, applying strace options if configured.

methods.name: ReadMonitorSocketLoop
methods.description: Listens for control messages from the parent process, such as stop, suspend, or resume commands.

methods.name: SuspendHostProcessesImpl
methods.description: Handles suspending host processes via inter-process communication.

methods.name: ResumeHostProcessesImpl
methods.description: Handles resuming host processes via inter-process communication.

methods.name: SuspendMonitoredProcesses
methods.description: Sends a suspend command to the monitor process.

methods.name: ResumeMonitoredProcesses
methods.description: Sends a resume command to the monitor process.

methods.name: StartAndMonitorProcesses
methods.description: Initializes and starts the monitoring routine for subprocesses, including setting up communication channels.

methods.name: MonitorRoutine
methods.description: Main loop for monitoring subprocesses, handling their exit events and restarting if necessary.
